subject: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist

Hi team,

Acme (Sara) is planning to ingest their ORANGE-0.9 variant into production for a closed beta next month. Product is asking for a short-lived pin so they can get deterministic results while we finish a telemetry gap. Before we commit, we need a quick compatibility and safety checklist and a proposed rollback/telemetry gating plan.

Key asks:
- Can infra confirm ORANGE-0.9 is ABI/kv-cache compatible with our 2048-sequence runtime (tokenizer parity, kv layout)?
- Ops: what telemetry signals do we need to unblock a temporary pin? (SLO breach thresholds, perplexity/regression alerts, token-rate anomalies)
- Sales/partnership: can we align contract language for a provisional pin (30 days) and include a clause for forced rollback if regressions appear?

I've attached a short compatibility summary from Acme and a draft runbook. Can we do a short sync today or tomorrow and surface any blockers? Sara — thanks for sending the ORANGE compatibility PDF.

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara@acme.ai>, vendor-ops@modelhub.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist

Thanks Marissa — looping infra and ops. Karthik, can you confirm the ABI/tokenizer parity check timeline? If infra signs off, I can draft the provisional pin language for Acme and the internal rollout guardrails.

Provisional commercial note: we should treat this as a short-term addendum (30-day pin) that explicitly requires agreed telemetry (see Marissa's list) and a mutually agreed rollback window. I will coordinate with Legal once we have technical signoff.

Quick availability: I can do a 30-min call today 2:00–3:00pm PT or tomorrow morning.

-Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sara Liu <sara@acme.ai>, vendor-ops@modelhub.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist

On Thu, May 27, 2027 at 10:02 AM Ben Carter wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — looping infra and ops. Karthik, can you confirm the ABI/tokenizer parity check timeline? If infra signs off, I can draft the provisional pin language for Acme and the internal rollout guardrails.

Quick update from infra: we ran the tokenizer parity smoke locally against the ORANGE token-spec and found two edge-case mismatches in our whitespace handling at the subtoken boundary (details in attached patch notes). Those are fixable without a model rebuild but require a tokenizer shim that we can deploy to staging in ~48 hours.

Compatibility summary (short):
- KV layout: compatible (no layout changes)
- Attention kernels: compatible on our current runtime (no special kernels required)
- Tokenizer: two edge-case differences — require shim to avoid divergent token counts on some inputs
- Binary-size/quant: no anomalies observed in quant trace

If Ops is comfortable with a staged deployment (staging -> canary -> 10% production) with immediate telemetry gating, infra can support a provisional pin starting 2027-06-01. We should make the pin conditional on the shim deployment and a signed telemetry checklist.

Karthik
Sr. Staff Engineer, Infra


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@acme.ai>, vendor-ops@modelhub.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist

On Thu, May 27, 2027 at 1:34 PM Karthik Iyer wrote:
> If Ops is comfortable with a staged deployment (staging -> canary -> 10% production) with immediate telemetry gating, infra can support a provisional pin starting 2027-06-01. We should make the pin conditional on the shim deployment and a signed telemetry checklist.

Thanks — ops can own the telemetry gating. Proposed minimum signals for provisional pin:
- Token-level latency (p99) — must be within 10% of baseline for first 72 hours
- Error rate (model-exceptions, OOMs) — < 0.1%
- Quality guardrail: automated eval on a 200-sample prompt set (seeded by Acme and Redwood) with an allowed regression threshold of 2% on the primary metrics (fidelity/semantic match).
- Drift detector: spike in unknown tokens/out-of-vocab occurrences > 0.5% triggers immediate canary rollback.

Operational cadence:
1) Deploy tokenizer shim to staging and run a 24h soak with full telemetry.
2) Canary at 5% traffic for 24h with telemetry monitoring and manual signoff.
3) Expand to 10% for 48h.

If all signals are green, Ops will approve a temporary pin window of up to 30 days from the production date (2027-06-03 -> 2027-07-03). Any regression during that period gives us the right to revoke the pin and failover to the previous variant.

I'll draft the telemetry checklist and attach the runbook.

- Stephanie
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference


From: Sara Liu <sara@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, vendor-ops@modelhub.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORANGE variant intake: temporary pin exception and integration checklist

Thanks everyone — this is great and very clear. Acme is fine with the tokenizer shim deployment and the staged rollout. We accept the provisional 30-day pin window conditional on the telemetry gating and the ability for Redwood to revoke the pin if regressions occur.

Action items agreed:
- Infra (Karthik) will push the tokenizer shim to staging by EOD 2027-05-29.
- Ops (Stephanie) will run the soak tests and publish the telemetry checklist by 2027-05-31.
- Ben will produce a provisional pin addendum and coordinate Legal for a 30-day clause (target to sign by 2027-06-02).
- Marissa will create the intake ticket and link to the Confluence page.

Attachments: ORANGE compatibility PDF (sent earlier), proposed runbook (staggered-rollout-runbook.md).

Looking forward to the staged rollout — Sara
VP, Platform Partnerships
Acme AI
